headline: 1,199 candidates now have a photo on the site
body: On 16 November 2026, 1,199 of the 15,137 named candidates on this site have a photo, in 908 of the 1,489 races.
Each photo comes from a source that names the candidate, and each is checked against the gender and age INEC printed for them.
Every candidate without a photo shows the same plain placeholder.
Candidates and their campaigns can send a photo from the About page; nothing sent that way appears until it has been checked.

headline: Who’s on my ballot? is live for the 2027 elections
body: This site shows every race on the ballot at each polling unit in Nigeria’s 2027 general elections, with every candidate side by side.
The candidates are those on INEC’s final lists, updated on 31 October 2026: 15,137 named candidates for President, Governor, the Senate, the House of Representatives and the State Houses of Assembly.
Voting is on 16 January 2027 for President, the Senate and the House of Representatives, and on 6 February 2027 for Governor in 28 states and for the State Houses of Assembly.
You can find your ballot by state, LGA, ward and polling unit, by the code on your voter’s card, or by searching for a landmark near where you vote.
